fit_reason: These are two antique wooden cedar-strip rowboats sold as restoration projects or display pieces. They are painted wood, not gelcoat, and need carpentry and refinishing work like gunwale and transom repair, which a detail cannot address.
findings: Peeling and flaking white paint on the hull of the yellow-interior boat
Weathered, worn blue paint along the hull side of the second boat
Bare, grayed wood ribs and seats inside the second boat
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the two Larson cedar strip rowboats. They look like neat restoration pieces, but the peeling paint and weathered wood are more of a strip-and-refinish job than a detail. We focus on gelcoat and paint polishing, so we wouldn't be the right fit here. Best of luck with the sale.
